dct_title_s: West Indies, Cuba--north coast, Ports on the north coast of Cuba (Raster Image)
dct_description_sm: Prepared and published by the Defense Mapping Agency. Depths shown by isolines and soundings. Relief shown by contours and spot heights. "From U.S. Navy surveys to 1932 and Cuban charts of 1975." "Copyright 1996 by the United States Government. No copyright claimed under Title 17 U.S.C." "Soundings in meters." Components: Bahía de Sagua de Tánamo -- Cayo Moa Grande -- Puerto Baracoa. Includes inset. Includes compilation diagram and tidal information. Map NO.26245
This map is part of a collection of scanned and georeferenced nautical charts produced by the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA).
